name: get_layer
description: A layer's property tree (transform, masks, effects, text, shape contents, ...): every node has a `path` usable with get_property/set_property/add_keyframe, plus uid, match id, name, type, value at `time`, keyframes and expression. `flat: true` returns just a list of {path, type, value, keys, expression} (compact).

comp.description: Composition item id or name; omit for the active comp.

flat.description: Return a flat list of properties instead of the tree.

layer.description: Layer id (from get_comp), "#n" (1-based index from the top) or layer name.

time.description: Comp time in seconds for values (default: current time).
